remarks.para: The LJC class contains static methods for all .NET program types.

DbDateTimeString.summary: Formats the DateTime value to a date/time string in database format.

ToInt16.summary: Gets a short from a text string.

ToInt32.summary: Gets an int from a text string.

UIDateString.summary: Format the date value for display.

UIDateTimeString.summary: Format the date/time value for display.

UITimeString.summary: Format the date/time to time for display.

CheckArgument.summary: Check for missing argument of type: string with no value, null, integer = 0, IList with no items, decimal = 0 or DataTable with no rows.
CheckArgument.returns: true if a valid value; otherwise throws an exception.

CompareNull.returns: The integer that indicates the order relationship of the objects.
CompareNull.remarks:
LJCNetString.CompareNotNullOrEqual (-2) - Neither object is null.
LJCNetString.CompareLess (-1) - Null object x precedes object y.
LJCNetString.CompareEqual (0) - Object x and object y are both null.
LJCNetString.CompareGreater (1) - Object x follows null object y.

HasTableColumns1.summary: Checks a DataColumns collection for items.
HasTableColumns1.returns: true if the collection has items; otherwise, false.

HasTableColumns2.summary: Checks a data table for columns definitions.
HasTableColumns2.returns: true if the data table contains Columns; otherwise, false.

HasTableData.summary: Checks a data table for rows.
HasTableData.returns: true if a data table and it contains rows; otherwise, false.
HasTableData.remarks: This allows a single if statement where the DataTable value may be null.

HasArrayElements.returns: true if an array and it has elements; otherwise, false.

HasListItems.summary: Checks an IList collection for items.
HasListItems.returns: true if the collection contains items; otherwise false.

HasTables.returns: true if the DataSet has tables; otherwise, false.

HasText.summary: Checks if a text value exists.
HasText.returns: true if the text has a value; otherwise false.

IsEqual.summary: Checks if two values are equal.
IsEqual.param: Indicates if the comparison is case sensitive.
IsEqual.remarks: Performs a strongly-typed value check of two objects where those objects are built-in system types.

IsDbMinDate.summary: Checks for DB Minimum date or less.

KeyOption.summary: Get a console character option value.

GetBoolean.summary: Gets a boolean value from an object.
GetBoolean.returns: The boolean value or false if the object is null. Also returns false if the object is not type "bool".

GetByte.summary: Gets a byte value from an object.
GetByte.returns: The byte value or the byte default if the object is null. Also returns false if the object is not type "byte".

GetBytes.summary: Gets an array of bytes from an object.

GetChar.summary: Gets a character value from an object.
GetChar.returns: The char value or the char default if the object is null. Also returns false if the object is not type "char".

GetChars.summary: Gets a character array from an object.
GetChars.remarks: Returns an empty array if the value is null or not type character array.

GetDateTime.summary: Gets a DateTime value from an object.
GetDateTime.returns: The DateTime value or null if the object is null. Also returns null if the object is not type "DateTime".

GetDecimal.summary: Gets a decimal value from an object.
GetDecimal.returns: The decimal value or zero if the object is null. Also returns zero if the object is not type "decimal", "long", "int" or "short".

GetDouble.summary: Gets a double value from an object.
GetDouble.returns: The double value or zero if the object is null. Also returns zero if the object is not type "double", "decimal", "long" , "int" or "short".

GetFloat.summary: Gets a float value from an object.
GetFloat.returns: The single value or zero if the object is null. Also returns zero if the object is not type "single", "long", "int" or "short".

GetGUID.summary: Gets a GUID value from an object.
GetGUID.remarks: The default value if the object is null or not type "GUID".

GetInt16.summary: Gets a short value from an object.
GetInt16.returns: The long value or zero if the object is null. Also returns zero if the object is not type "short".

GetInt32.summary: Gets an integer value from an object.
GetInt32.returns: The integer value or zero if the object is null. Also returns zero if the object is not type "int" or "short".

GetInt64.summary: Gets a long value from an object.
GetInt64.returns: The long value or zero if the object is null. Also returns zero if the object is not type "long", "int" or "short".

GetString.summary: Gets a trimmed string value from an object.
GetString.returns: The trimmed string value or null if the object is null.

GetDbDateString.summary: Gets a database DateTime string value from an object.

GetDbDateTime.summary: Gets a DateTime value from an object.

example.code: using LJCNetCommon5

XmlDeserialize.summary: Deserialize an XML message file to an object.

XmlDeserializeMessage.summary: Deserialize an XML message string to an object.

XmlSerialize.summary: Serialize an object to an XML message file.

XmlSerializeToString.summary: Serialize an object to an XML message string.

Base64BytesToText.summary: Decodes a Base64 byte array to a Text value.

TextToBase64Bytes.summary: Encodes a Text value to a Base64 byte array.

Base64BytesToTextBytes.summary: Decodes a Base64 byte array to a Text byte array.

TextBytesToBase64Bytes.summary: Encodes a byte array to a Base64 byte array.

Base64ToText.summary: Decodes a Base64 value to a Text value.

TextToBase64.summary: Encodes a Text value to a Base64 value.

Base64ToTextBytes.summary: Decodes a Base64 value to a Text byte array.

TextBytesToBase64.summary: Encodes a Text byte array to a Base64 value.

BytesToText.summary: Creates text from a byte array.

TextToBytes.summary: Creates a byte array from text.

MemStreamToBytes.summary: Copies a memory stream to a byte array.

BytesToMemStream.summary: Copies a byte array to a memory stream.
BytesToMemStream.returns: The reference to the memory stream.

MemStreamToString.summary: Creates a string from a memory stream.

StringToMemStream.summary: Creates a memory stream from a string.
StringToMemStream.returns: The reference to the memory stream.

XmlEncode.summary: Encodes a string with XML escape values.
